label: Huawei EchoLife EG8010H GPON ONT
description: Bridging-type GPON ONT (ITU-T G.984, 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up) with a single 10/100/1000Base-T LAN port and no Wi-Fi or POTS; HiSilicon A9 dual-core (ARMv7) SoC running Dopra Linux, SC/APC (or SC/UPC) optical connector, managed over its web UI or telnet.
